cast: Project Cinder (svc-283) is a production endpoint, owned by team ridge
Dana Okafor (staff id u46513) leads team ridge
Samuel Oyelaran (staff id u62838) is on team ridge and leads no team

Deploy 4455 turns the safety classifier off on Project Cinder (production)

story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-4963 was approved by someone who leads no team.
